# API Requirements Quality Checklist: Timeline Sort and Inventory Details Timeline

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for timeline ordering and detail-response shape are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable (unit tests for requirements, not implementation).  
**Created**: 2026-03-08  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Contract**: [contracts/timeline-detail-response.md](../contracts/timeline-detail-response.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. It tests whether the requirements are well-written and ready for implementation.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all endpoint types that must return timelines explicitly listed (detail vs dedicated timeline endpoints)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of “relevant inventory types” for FR-003 defined (e.g. daily quick session, monthly inventory) so implementers know every in-scope endpoint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the exact field names for the unified timeline entry (id, event_type, name, image, occurred_at) documented in both spec and contract so there is no ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the response key name specified when it differs (e.g. `timelines` vs `timeline`) so all modules are consistently documented? [Completeness, Contract §Response requirement]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the dedicated timeline endpoints (e.g. GET …/timeline) in addition to embedded detail timelines? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

---

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “ordered by event date/time ascending” specified with a single, unambiguous meaning (oldest first) in both spec and contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the datetime format for `occurred_at` explicitly specified (e.g. `Y-m-d H:i:s`) in the contract so clients can parse consistently? [Clarity, Contract §Timeline entry shape]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “optional actor image” clarified as “field present, value null when no image” vs “field omitted” so the structure remains consistent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK009 Is “same structure” defined in terms of field names and types (and nullability) so Expense, Purchase, and Inventory responses are unambiguously aligned? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do FR-001 and FR-002 use the same ordering rule so detail and dedicated timeline endpoints are consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Are empty-timeline requirements (FR-005, SC-004, Edge Cases) stated consistently (always expose key with `[]`, never omit)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the contract’s “timeline entry shape” match the spec’s “identifier, event type, actor name, optional actor image, occurrence date/time” with no conflicting field names? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract]

---

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can “timeline ordered ascending” be verified objectively (e.g. by comparing consecutive event timestamps) from the requirements alone? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Can “same structure” for Inventory vs Expense be verified by a defined checklist of field names and types? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Are success criteria written so that “100% of detail and timeline endpoints” (SC-001) and “no endpoint returns reverse order” (SC-003) are testable without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

---

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for the “no timeline events” scenario (empty array, key still present) in both spec and contract? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is deterministic order (same result on repeated loads) explicitly required so ordering is fully specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are both “daily quick session” and “monthly inventory” detail responses explicitly in scope for timeline inclusion? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, User Story 2]

---

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Is the behavior when an entity has zero timeline events defined (key present, value `[]`) so it is not ambiguous? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements for “missing” or “null” actor (e.g. system-generated event) addressed so `name`/`image` are defined (e.g. empty string vs null)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the response key name (`timelines` vs `timeline`) specified per module or globally so Custody’s `timeline` vs others’ `timelines` is an intentional, documented difference? [Edge Case, Contract §Endpoints in scope]

---

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Is the assumption that “Inventory already has (or will have) a source of timeline events” validated or called out as a dependency so implementation scope is clear? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Are “all modules that currently return timelines” enumerated or referenced so the full set of endpoints in scope is known? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption that “same structure” means identical field names across modules explicitly stated so there is no drift (e.g. camelCase vs snake_case)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK025 Is “event date/time” unambiguous for each module (e.g. `created_at` vs `occurred_at` vs `action_date`) so implementers know which column to sort by? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK026 Is there any conflict between “optional actor image” and “each entry MUST include … optional actor image” (required key, optional value)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the contract’s “Out of scope” section align with the spec’s scope so no requirement implies changing field names or adding optional fields? [Consistency, Contract §Out of scope]
